title: The dangling else: a FIRST/FOLLOW conflict
notes: S → iSE | a, E → eS | ε. After i i a, does the e belong to the inner if or the outer one? e is in FIRST(eS) and in FOLLOW(E), so M[E, e] gets both rules. Taking the first rule gives the usual answer: the nearest if.
